summary: The supplied disagreement is most coherently read as a short-horizon pullback and leverage-stress signal nested within a positive 68-hour price structure, rather than as confirmation of either broad continuation or a confirmed multi-day reversal. Its strongest falsification is the latest-capture rebound in BTC and ETH, the breadth improvement subject to changing membership, and supportive ETH spot microstructure. This is a shadow-only conflict interpretation; no canonical state, action, or forecast candidate is implied.
